source_title: Agent of Empires (AoE) — Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Pi.dev session manager via tmux and git Worktrees
verdict: HIGH — directly validates and productizes our tmux+worktree architecture in Rust; three patterns (remain-on-exit, status detection, per-repo hooks) are immediately actionable

discovered_urls.title: ClawHub — agent tools registry (new platform signal)
discovered_urls.notes: AoE has a ClawHub profile. ClawHub appears to be an emerging AI agent tools registry — worth tracking as a discovery surface for future catalogue entries. Not yet ingested.

discovered_urls.title: AoE Worktree Guide — parallel agents on different branches
discovered_urls.notes: Official AoE documentation for the bare repo + worktree workflow. Contains concrete setup patterns for parallel multi-agent branch isolation. Worth reading before implementing Phase 2 worktree improvements.

discovered_urls.title: AoE Repo Config & Hooks Guide — per-project settings and automation
discovered_urls.notes: Documents the .aoe/config.toml lifecycle hooks system (before_agent_start, after_agent_stop). Direct reference for redesigning our .bmad/scripts/ approach.

discovered_urls.title: agent-deck — Go + Bubble Tea agent session manager (AoE's inspiration)
discovered_urls.notes: AoE README credits agent-deck as inspiration. Go + Bubble Tea TUI stack vs AoE's Rust. May have different architectural patterns worth comparing. Not yet ingested.
